title: PromoCodeElementProps
description: The props of a Promo code: an optional title, the code itself, an optional note and a light or dark theme. The code shows in a chip with a Copy button, and it is visible to every visitor, so it is not a secret. All text is plain, on one line, without control characters. A tale may hold several Promo codes.

title.description: A short heading above the code; none when left out.

code.description: The code visitors copy: 1 to 32 letters, digits, underscores or hyphens (`A-Z`, `a-z`, `0-9`, `_`, `-`).

note.description: A short line under the code, such as its terms; none when left out.

theme.description: `light` draws dark text on a light card; `dark` light text on a dark card. Light when left out.
